title: Up to 5 representative ring-1 articles behind one ranked topic in one week
description: BigQuery radar.topic_evidence_weekly from radar.gkg_ai + radar.article_segment for the top 30 ranked topics of each recent week -> lake/gold/topic_evidence_weekly.parquet. Titles and URLs are public news metadata: they live in the lake and on the deployed site only, never in git, so this contract is never mocked.

why_selected.description: the stated rule that picked it, for example 'most of the week's top co-mentioned entities, distinct source'
